answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose HETFORMER, a HETerogeneous transFORMER-based pre-trained model for long-text extractive summarization using multi-granularity sparse attentions.

answer_2.quote: We use unigram, bigram, and longest common subsequence of Rouge F1 (denoted as R-1, R-2 and R-L) to evaluate the summarization qualities.
